turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good, good. Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just got invited to a final round interview.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Congratulations! In person or video?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: In person, at their office.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then let's talk outfit. Are you thinking a full suit, or smart casual like a blazer and nice trousers?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Chloe something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you come back early today?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, my meeting got cancelled.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you been practicing your guitar this week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little. My fingertips still hurt on the steel strings.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That goes away after a few weeks. Which song are you learning?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just the easy campfire ones. Four chords, over and over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's how everyone starts. Play me one later?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if you promise not to laugh.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were deciding between a suit and smart casual for your interview.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Suit. It's a bank, they're pretty formal.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then a suit is right. Make sure it's pressed and your shoes are polished, the details get noticed.
